from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

img = Image.open('radiograph.jpg')
w, h = img.size

# Let's draw bounding boxes on the original image and inspect them
boxes = [
    [0.490, 0.235, 0.515, 0.285],
    [0.492, 0.240, 0.512, 0.280],
]

for i, box in enumerate(boxes):
    vis = img.copy().convert('RGB')
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(vis)
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = [int(v * (w if j%2==0 else h)) for j, v in enumerate(box)]
    draw.rectangle([x1, y1, x2, y2], outline='red', width=3)
    # Save a crop around it
    vis.crop((x1 - 100, y1 - 100, x2 + 100, y2 + 100)).save(f'box_test_{i}.png')
